title: Tsang Chiu Ho Building
geometryBasis: The named seven-point footprint fixes the building at the Wellington Street and Aberdeen Street corner. The Town Planning Board confirms the address and records the ground and two upper commercial floors with six residential floors above.
sectionBasis: Original photographs from the same 18 May 2024 series establish the glazed red shopfront, projecting green signs, first-floor dark bands, and orange and cream residential facade. Official native Hong Kong 1980 Grid ground elevations fix the neighborhood slope.
limitations: The model depicts the Wellington Street premises in May 2024, after reopening and before the May 2026 relocation to Sheung Wan.
Ground-floor thresholds and exact upper floor and parapet heights are approximated. The side wall uses a simplified color treatment, and the rear and roof equipment are generalised.
The café interior and adjoining buildings are outside the model scope. The Hong Kong DTM is an independent 5 m grid and supplies approximate sidewalk grades.
